I still remember how i first discovered Morrowind. A Demo of the game came in my monthly subscription of some PC Magazine. It had only Balmora and Caldera in it, and it was kinda new and awesome but also somewhat scary. I wasn't into RPG's at the time...

I rediscovered Morrowind later in life, and i am still hooked and have it installed ever since! Every time i play it, i find some cave, some storyline or some little content i somehow missed. I love this game, one of the best ones ever made! My last character was a Redguard with a spear and focus on athletics, aerobics, strength and all that. Got the idea from some YouTube Channel (wabbajerks) and it is fucking fun to play. I just jump around, OP as hell and stab everything.

What is your favorite character? When and how did you discover Morrowind? What is your favorite aspect about the game?
Oh man, I loved this game. I think I picked it up when I was 13 and played every day for 3 years straight. Just exploring every little book and cranny. Nothing will ever compare to this game.

Yeah, some games are just good in memory. Like Settlers 2. I played it again recently, me and a buddy from elementary school used to play it on his moms PC! But it was better in memory than in real life. After about 2 games it gets repetitive! But MW I still play every now and then! It is just a very good game. And with graphic mods and/or OpenMW it is just an awesome experience!

Last year there was a Saturday that I didn't have anything to do for the entire day. I ended up playing Morrowind for about 10 hours, only breaking to eat, hit the head, and get more beer. It has been almost a decade since I have been able to waste an entire day playing video games and being able to do that was great. I spent a large portion of that day moving items from the abandoned shack near Gnaar Mok to Mournhold to sell to the armor merchant. And then I spent some time hunting Golden Saints to soul trap them into grand soul gens to use for constant effect enchantments.

I always knew about Morrowind but when it came out I was not into PC gaming and I didn't have an xbox, so I didn't care about it. Fast forward many years later I stumble upon OpenMW and got a copy of Morrowind to play with. Now that OpenMW is so close to a 1.0 release, I have been able to play it to completion and am now going back and playing a mage class.

This is awesome. You can get really lost in Morrowind, looking at the clock and wondering how the fuck 6 hours went by. Those constant effect items are a lifesaver! I love the way enchanting and alchemy works in this game. OpenMW is just awesome! I started my last playthrough with it, and it is the best way to play Morrowind imo. Sure, some mods don't work, but you don't really need more than textures and some other simple stuff.
